summary: fix(tests): stop three nightly tests from flaking
description:
Because:

- Three tests flake on nightly CI: PromotionBanner dismiss,
  PageDomainBlocklist paging and signinBlocked unverified.

This commit:

- Uses Jest fake timers for the PromotionBanner dismiss timer.
- Uses PAGE_SIZE + 3 entries and one Next click in the paging test.
- Waits for the confirm_signup_code heading in signinBlocked unverified.

Closes FXA-14944
